title: What actor do you think had the absolute highest performance ceiling?

commenti.body:
Nicholson is a lot of fun to watch, but part of what makes DDL so great is his gargantuan range. Nicholson has more range than say, Robert De Niro, but it's not a ton.

That said, you don't necessarily need a ton of range to be great. Case in point: Robert De Niro

Yes but Marlon Brando in the 1950s and early 1970s was in a different realm. Jack and Marlon were neighbors on Mulholland Dr and Jack rightly revered Marlon. Watch On the Waterfront, The Godfather, Last Tango in Paris. Three hugely distinct movies but Brando dominated all three.

Love Nicholson but for me it often feel his lack of range. He’s brilliant but he’s almost always him. His voice and his smirk and his crazy eyes. I don’t feel an utter transformation like I do with Cillian Murphy. 

Maybe Cate Blanchett. Her range is insane. I watched I’m Not There and I still can’t get over her Bob Dylan. Could anyone else pull off Katherine Hepburn without it seeming like a caricature? The nuance in her Elizabeth. Veronica Guerin. Tar. Carol. And then she absolutely obliterates as Hela in Thor. 

And before I go, I just really need to reiterate she played the most mind blowing Bob Dylan. How is that even possible?

I fully believe that if Marilyn Monroe hadn’t died young, she would have continued to study, grow, and eventually ditch the screen siren persona and act a wide range of characters well! People forget about her utter devotion to studying and Lee Strasberg.

Good actors who don’t take the time to properly train are a true tragedy in film. Take Cher for example. Silkwood, Mask, Witches of Eastwick, Moonstruck. Imagine what she could have done if she went to an acting studio, or hired a private coach. She’s good in what she gave us, but the tragedy is the wasted potential. Halle Berry is another example of wasted potential due to not training with an acting coach.

An old fashioned acting style that might not be your cup of tea, is used by Joan Crawford. She played such a wide range of characters. From The Women to Trog. She always captures the viewer!
Cate isn’t sufficiently recognized as one of the greatest actors of her generation. Love her!

I agree. I rarely hear people mention her as a top actor. 

Denzel is up there. Cillian. De Niro. Pacino before he got shouty. Meryl Streep. Paul Newman. Viola Davis. Samantha Morton feels underrated. 

Another stunning but much newer actor I’ve been seeing recently is Jessica Buckley. She never misses the mark. Phenomenal.
